record.question: Regarding congenital lobar emphysema (CLE), the following are true EXCEPT
options: usually no cause of CLE can be identified
usually become apparent in the neonatal period
many cases are diagnosed by antenatal ultrasonography
record.explanation: The stem's true statements (familial reports, no identifiable cause, neonatal presentation) are consistent with the literature, and the antenatal ultrasound statement is the least supported; the item is not fully certain.
